natural_earth.license: Public domain; source project requests citation/attribution
natural_earth.vintage: Natural Earth reference dataset; source snapshot commit pins exact version, underlying feature data are not observation-dated
natural_earth.restoration: Fetch each listed source path at the pinned Natural Earth commit. The exact four selected ADM1 records and one COM ADM0 record used for comparisons are retained as GeoJSON extracts; extracted-record hashes are the primary evidence hashes.

comoros_composite_identity.note: Current feature metadata identifies an Atlas source aggregation and claims its underlying licenses are retained in semantic-report.json; the root semantic-report.json does not contain a geoBoundaries source license record. The exact original three OSM/Wambacher source features and their ODbL metadata/citation are retained here. Natural Earth COM-4935 is comparison context only, not political ownership evidence.

limits: Published baseline/source matching does not certify administrative authority, current settlement completeness, complete coastlines, inclusion of every island or any location attribute import.

full_resolution_L1_member.scope_method: Screened every L1 land polygon against all 144 assigned geometries in EPSG:6933; retain matched source candidates as binary extract with scripts and raw-source restoration hashes.

additional_sources.uncertainty: Resolution is finite; source nonintersection does not prove physical land absent, especially reef/islet/coastal features.

madagascar_disconnected_component_screen.method: All OCHA COD-AB Madagascar ADM2 components larger than 0.01 km2 with less than 1% overlap against current 119-member Madagascar union are screened against full-resolution GSHHG L1; zero intersected. Non-detection remains inconclusive.
